heading: 参考资料

sources.title: Using HTTP cookies
supports: 登录成功后可用Cookie保存会话ID，后续合适请求携带ID，由服务器检查会话是否有效
Set-Cookie指示浏览器保存Cookie，后续Cookie请求字段传回；删除Cookie需要匹配其命名与作用范围
sources.sections: What cookies are used for；Creating, removing, and updating cookies／Creating cookies／Removal: defining the lifetime of a cookie

articleOnlySupports: Secure、HttpOnly、SameSite等发送与访问边界只在配套文章拓展，不标作视频已展开。

quotation.text: The browser sends the cookie containing the session ID along with the corresponding request to indicate that it still thinks the user is signed in.
quotation.locator: What cookies are used for · line 18

sources.title: Session Management Cheat Sheet
supports: 会话编号应不可预测、无业务含义且不包含敏感账户数据；编号含义与关联状态由服务器保存
会话过期或退出时服务端必须使会话失效，只删除浏览器Cookie不能替代服务端撤销

articleOnlySupports: 浏览器会话恢复可能保留会话Cookie，不能仅凭关闭浏览器断言登录已结束。

quotation.text: When a session expires, the web application must take active actions to invalidate the session on both sides, client and server.
